description: This Java source file defines the SwaggerConfiguration class for configuring Swagger/OpenAPI documentation in the Thingsboard server. It sets up API info, security schemes, customizes schema representations, and manages API responses and tags.

classes.name: SwaggerConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, including API info, security schemes, schema customizations, and API responses.

methods.name: configureModelResolver
methods.description: Initializes model resolver settings, enabling enum references and schema replacements for ByteBuffer.

methods.name: thingsboardApi
methods.description: Creates and configures the OpenAPI object with API info, security schemes, and customizations.

methods.name: springDocConfig
methods.description: Configures SpringDoc properties, setting OpenAPI version and reference handling.

methods.name: swaggerUiConfig
methods.description: Configures Swagger UI display options such as deep linking, sorting, and theme.

methods.name: addLoginOperation
methods.description: Adds the login endpoint operation to the OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: addRefreshTokenOperation
methods.description: Adds the token refresh endpoint operation to the OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: groupedApi
methods.description: Creates a grouped OpenAPI definition for the API endpoints.

methods.name: mapAwareConverter
methods.description: Custom ModelConverter that handles special types and precomputes property order and ownership for schemas.

methods.name: addDefaultSchemas
methods.description: Adds common error and request/response schemas to the OpenAPI components.

methods.name: operationCustomizer
methods.description: Customizes API operations, setting default summaries if missing.

methods.name: customOpenApiCustomizer
methods.description: Main method to customize the OpenAPI object, including sorting, schema fixing, and response adjustments.

methods.name: createSecurityRequirement
methods.description: Creates a security requirement object for a given scheme.

methods.name: extractTagFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the tag name from a PathItem based on its operations.

methods.name: tagFromTagItem
methods.description: Creates a Tag object from a tag string, formatting the name and description.

methods.name: defaultErrorResponsesCustomization
methods.description: Adds default error responses to API operations for a given PathItem.

methods.name: securityCustomization
methods.description: Applies security requirements to API operations based on path regex matching.

methods.name: loginResponses
methods.description: Defines standard responses for login API, including success and error cases.

methods.name: defaultErrorResponses
methods.description: Defines standard error responses for non-POST API calls.

methods.name: loginErrorResponses
methods.description: Defines error responses specific to login failures, including various unauthorized scenarios.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Constructs an ApiResponse with error details and examples.

methods.name: collectAllProperties
methods.description: Recursively collects all properties from schemas, following allOf references.

methods.name: deduplicateAllOfProperties
methods.description: Removes inherited properties from allOf schemas that are not declared as own properties.

methods.name: resolveSchemaName
methods.description: Generates the schema name used by swagger-core for a given JavaType.

methods.name: computeOwnPropNames
methods.description: Determines the JSON property names directly declared in a class, not inherited.

methods.name: reorderSchemaProperties
methods.description: Reorders schema properties based on a specified property order list.

methods.name: reorderProperties
methods.description: Reorders a map of properties according to a specified order, appending remaining alphabetically.

methods.name: resolvePropertyOrder
methods.description: Resolves the property order for a class, considering annotations and declaration order.

methods.name: errorExample
methods.description: Creates an example object for error responses, adding a timestamp.

methods.name: replaceInlineOneOfInContent
methods.description: Replaces inline oneOf schemas in content with $ref to base types.

methods.name: findBaseTypeForOneOf
methods.description: Finds the base type for a oneOf schema, considering discriminators and mappings.

methods.name: replaceInlineOneOfProperties
methods.description: Replaces inline oneOf schemas within properties and additionalProperties with $ref to base types.
